purpose: Strengthen Qoder Cloud Agent usage evidence with bounded read-only rubric auditing and evidence watchdog checks.

output_access_check.conclusion: Cloud task creation is confirmed, but execution output is not retrievable through the available local interface.

runs.name: Moo-Moo Rubric Auditor
runs.prompt_summary: Independently score the supplied Moo-Moo evidence against the official 25/30/30/15 rubric, identify gaps, and recommend the five highest-impact improvements. No tools, network, accounts, files, orders, or trades.
runs.output_status: Cloud task creation confirmed; local agent cannot read Cloud execution output through available tools.

runs.name: Moo-Moo Evidence Watchdog
runs.prompt_summary: Check the supplied artifact manifest and claims for consistency, missing evidence, private-data redaction risk, and unsupported statements. Return PASS/FAIL/REVIEW and remediation. No tools, network, accounts, files, orders, or trades.
runs.output_status: Cloud task creation confirmed; local agent cannot read Cloud execution output through available tools.

notes: Task creation is not evidence of completed work; outputs must be captured after execution.
The runs use the Qoder Cloud default environment and do not inherit local files, tools, connectors, credentials, or the current model.
The existing 17 November reporter/auditor/watchdog deployment evidence remains separate from these new automation runs.
